title: setup
description: Payload of `stride setup [key=value]`: where the first-run walk stands and what the next step needs. The steps run in order (init, strava_app, authorize, timezone, zones, sync); a step is done when the database already holds what it would write.

complete.description: true when every step is done.

next_step.description: The first step not yet done; done when complete. init never appears here: setup creates the database itself.

interactive.description: true when the next step needs the athlete at a browser: creating the Strava API app, or clicking Authorize.

needs.description: The `key=value` inputs the next step takes, one per `stride setup` call. For zones either one of threshold_hr and max_hr does. Empty for sync, which is `stride sync` then `stride analyze`, and when complete.

instruction.description: What to do for the next step, in a sentence the coach can relay.

authorize_url.description: For strava_app, the Strava API settings page; for authorize, the page where the athlete clicks Authorize. Empty otherwise.

timezone_detected.description: The system's own IANA zone when the next step is timezone and one was found (TZ, the /etc/localtime link, or the Windows zone); empty otherwise. A suggestion to confirm, never stored by itself.

ran.description: What this call did: init when it created the database, and the key it applied when one was passed.

steps.description: Every step in order, with whether it is done.
